_doc: Campaign planets, keyed by planet id (see planet/planets/planet_envs.gd). env: script with static apply(world, field, kind) and optional dev_hub / prepare_field / dress_view. sky: the env's own sky preset values; fog / sun / ambient: daytime light (night is the env's own); palette: key colours; junk_tint: the frost/dust coat on junk; music_mood: key for the sound helper. Suns come from data/solar_system.json (SolarSystem.suns_for) when present; sun here is the fallback. Optional: junk_biome (Ochre: its biome set is registered by the env), no_lakes (no planet lakes in the field), pieces_mult (junk per hex).

hub_defaults._doc: [v6hubs] Every hub's purpose (planet/sites/hub_plan.gd, hub_purpose.gd; docs/ADJUSTING.md). main_path: how many hubs (the start hub included) are the planet's main path; the rest are optional extras. clean_hexes: hexes to clean at a far hub before its landmark can be woken. outposts: outposts to repair there first (0 = none). level_at: the hub's clean share at which a woken hub rises to level 3, 4 and 5 (the wake itself is level 2). A hub's own chain overrides the default chain. The wake price is data/hub.json far_hub_cost (Hub.far_cost).

hop._doc: [v6hubs] The rocket hop between hubs (planet/sites/hub_hop.gd) and the arrival (hub_purpose.gd show_title). leg_s: seconds of each visible leg (out, then in); leg_m: ground covered per leg; cruise_alt_m: flight height; fade_s: the sky veil's fade while the town builds; skip_after_s: E / jump skips the flight after this; approach_pitch / approach_dist_m: the camera on the way in. title_in_s / title_hold_s / title_out_s: the town's name, type and why we came; arrive_sting: the music sting on the first arrival at a hub ('' for none).

hubs._doc: [v6hubs] One entry per hub. site: SiteManager index (0 = start). order: place on the main path. town: the town's look (oldtown, downtown, suburb, industrial; VerdanceSite builds it, except where the lake reaches into the town, which is always a harbour). landmark.kind: StreetDressing landmark (water_tower, crane, ferris_wheel, radio_mast, smokestack, old_bus, windpump, lighthouse). desc: the picker's 'why go'. piece: the rocket piece the wake gives (flags rocket_piece_<id>, rocket_pieces). gift: cubes / parts / seeds / research (a node granted free) / design (a Lumi design) / flag. boosts (optional, none on Verdance: the per-hub multiplier is data/hub.json far_hub.sell_growth): stat multipliers while the hub is woken, [{stat, mult, text}] (Economy.stat ids; '*.speed' = every robot type). hint: the arrival line. chain: steps {do: clean, hexes} / {do: outposts, count} / {do: wake}.
hubs.name: Landing Yard
hubs.desc: Home. The pod, the workbench and your first robots.

hubs.name: Garden Row
hubs.desc: The Makers' seed store: seeds to take to the next world.
hubs.hint: The old gardens. The Windpump still holds a sealed seed store.

hubs.name: Gantry Works
hubs.desc: Hull plates, so the rocket can stand the cold of space.
hubs.hint: The shipyard. The Gantry Crane can lift the hull plates the rocket needs.

hubs.name: Signal Heights
hubs.desc: The Makers' star chart: it shows where the rocket can fly.
hubs.hint: The city centre. The Signal Mast kept the star chart of every route out.

hubs.name: Fairground
hubs.desc: A power cell that lasts a long flight. A new look for Lumi.
hubs.hint: The fairground. The Big Wheel's motor ran on a power cell that never ran down.

hubs.name: Stack Works
hubs.desc: Fuel for the rocket: the last piece.
hubs.hint: The fuel works. The tanks under the Tall Stack are still full.

hubs.name: Bus Depot
hubs.desc: An old station off the route. Wake it for Parts.

hubs.name: Crane Court
hubs.desc: An old station off the route. Wake it for Cubes.

hubs.name: Tank Hill
hubs.desc: An old station off the route. Wake it for Seeds.

hubs.name: Lake Light
hubs.desc: An old station off the route. Wake it for Cubes.

rime.name: Rime
rime.tagline: An ice moon, core-mined until it froze.

sites._doc: [p_seas] Placeable hub-site prefabs (planet/planets/rime/rime_site.gd): RimeHubSite.place(id, root, stage 0-2, restoration 0-1, {radius, seed}); a local ice patch about 80-90 m across (walkable trimesh, PROP colliders on every structure). Preview: res://planet/planets/rime/site_preview.tscn -- --site=<id>.

hub_camp.name: Drill Camp
hub_camp.desc: Cabins on skids round a plated yard, a greenhouse dome, fuel tanks, a comms mast and a snowcat.

derrick.name: Frozen Derrick
derrick.desc: A Ledger core-drill derrick frozen into the ice; a geothermal tap when restored.

borehole.name: The Borehole
borehole.desc: The shaft under its headframe and winder house; cold mist, then a warm glow.

hot_springs.name: Hot Springs
hot_springs.desc: Geothermal pools with a bathhouse and boardwalk; frozen, then steaming.

ochre.name: Ochre
ochre.tagline: The Ledger's first open-pit strip mine, closest to the twin suns.

sites.api: OchreSites.build(id, root, stage 1..5, restoration 0..1) -> Node3D, local +Y up, origin at the site centre

tidewell.name: Tidewell
tidewell.tagline: An ocean world. The Ledger's dredging rigs still stand in the shallows.

sites._doc: Placeable site prefabs for the walkable globe (planet/planets/tidewell/sites.gd): TideSite.place(id, root, stage 0-2, restoration 0-1, {water_radius, seed}); a local flat patch about 60-100 m across, sea level at y = 0.14, no world-origin assumptions. Preview: res://planet/planets/tidewell/site_preview.tscn -- --site=<id>.

hub_raft.name: Anchored Raft
hub_raft.desc: Timber raft deck on rusted pontoons: workshop shack, store, deck crane, fuel tank, moorings.

hub_stilts.name: Stilt Yard
hub_stilts.desc: A sandy islet with a stilt deck and huts over the water, boardwalk, beached skiff.

wreck.name: Ore Barge Wreck
wreck.desc: The Ledger's half-sunk mining barge by a sandbar; hoppers turn to planters when restored.

dredge_rig.name: Dredge Rig
dredge_rig.desc: A Ledger jack-up dredging rig with bucket ladder, derrick and crane.

reef_garden.name: Reef Garden
reef_garden.desc: Bleached coral breaking the surface among nets; live coral and floating gardens when restored.

buoy_field.name: Buoy Field
buoy_field.desc: Rows of mooring buoys strung with rope and ghost nets; light caps when futuristic.

anvil.name: Anvil

restored._doc: sky/fog targets at full restore: the dust sky clears to a pale terraformed blue

night._doc: night floor so the play area stays readable (ambient energy, warm ember-tinted fog light)

sites.name: Foundry Yard
sites.desc: hub base: casting hall, two stacks, conveyor truss and hopper, ore spur, ember slag tip, buried hauler

sites.name: Ledger Foundry Tower
sites.desc: the Ledger's colossal 130 m foundry stack on buttresses, pipes and slag tips

sites.name: Lava Forge
sites.desc: running furnace pouring molten slag down a channel to a pool; ladle crane; cools as restored

sites.name: Ruined Smelter
sites.desc: collapsed smelter hall frame, tipped and spilled pots, a toppled stack; restored as a planted pergola

anvil.sites_api: AnvilSites.build(site_root: Node3D, site_id, stage 1..5, restoration 0..1) -> Node3D; local +Y up, locally flat patch at the root's origin
